text: 我觉得最支持卖淫合法化的人应该就是我这类人——
en: I think the people who most support the legalisation of prostitution should be people like me—

text: 工作稳定，轻松，体面，但是收入微薄的小职员。
en: junior clerks with stable, easy and decent work, but meagre pay.

text: 工作的岗位难得，但是待遇一般，属于食之无味，弃之可惜。
en: The posts are hard to come by, yet the pay is mediocre — it is the kind of thing that tastes of nothing yet is a pity to discard.

text: 微薄的工资难以支持现在这个物质社会的两性关系发展。
en: A meagre salary can hardly sustain the development of relations between the sexes in today's material society.

text: 对于我这类人，嫖娼万一被抓，损失极大。
en: For people like me, if one were caught soliciting prostitution, the loss would be enormous.

text: 工作丢了，社会性也死亡了。
en: The job is lost, and one meets social death as well.

text: 前面的社保也白交了。
en: The social insurance paid in before is wasted too.

text: 如果是无业游民或者自由工作者，被抓了就抓了，啥损失没有。
en: If one were an unemployed drifter or a freelance worker, getting caught is simply getting caught — there is no real loss.

text: 我认为这个玩意从一定程度上控制着我这类人，逼我们买房结婚，成为国家的基本盘。
en: I believe this thing controls people like me to a certain extent, forcing us to buy homes and marry, becoming the bedrock of the state.

text: 另外，对于卖淫的惩罚我记得是相当轻微的，在实际操作中也颇有些视而不见的默契。
en: Besides, I recall that the punishment for prostitution is rather mild, and in practice there is a tacit understanding of turning a blind eye.

text: 保留一点卖淫场所，给社会底层的人一些廉价性资源的获取方式，应该也能从一定程度上维持社会稳定。
en: Keeping a few prostitution venues, giving those at the bottom of society some means of accessing cheap sexual resources, should also help maintain social stability to a certain extent.

text: ——我相信这正是我们现在采取的策略。
en: —I believe this is precisely the strategy we are now pursuing.

text: 名义上禁止，实际上放任，然后鱼和熊掌兼得…
en: Prohibited in name, tolerated in practice, and thus we enjoy the best of both worlds…

text: 更新一下新的观点。
en: Updating with a new point of view.

text: 我认为卖淫合法化是不可能在中国被推行的。
en: I think the legalisation of prostitution cannot possibly be implemented in China.

text: 这是我们国家的原则性的问题。
en: This is a matter of principle for our country.

text: 是立国之本（之一）。
en: It is one of the foundations upon which the nation is built.

text: 我们中国是以工人和农民阶级为代表的国家，这是写进宪法了的。
en: Our China is a country that represents the working and peasant classes, and this is written into the constitution.

text: 宪法 第一章 总纲 第一条　中华人民共和国是工人阶级领导的、以工农联盟为基础的人民民主专政的社会主义国家。
en: Constitution, Chapter I, General Principles, Article 1: The People's Republic of China is a socialist country under the people's democratic dictatorship led by the working class and based on the worker–peasant alliance.

text: 我们的立国之本就是保护人民（特别是底层百姓——工人，农民…
en: Our foundation as a nation is to protect the people (especially the common folk at the bottom — workers, peasants…

text: ）的利益，使人民不受压迫和剥削。
en: )'s interests, ensuring the people are free from oppression and exploitation.

text: 而卖淫的本质就是对妇女的剥削（从古至今都是，遥远的未来还是不是难说），卖淫合法化违反了宪法，动摇了根本，和共产主义的理想相悖。
en: Yet the essence of prostitution is the exploitation of women (true from ancient times to the present, whether it will remain so in the distant future is hard to say); the legalisation of prostitution violates the constitution, shakes the very foundation, and runs counter to the ideal of communism.

text: 所以卖淫合法化这件事，不论任何人任何势力，都是无法在中国推行下去的。
en: Therefore, the legalisation of prostitution is something that no person or power whatsoever can carry through in China.

text: 但还是那句话，虽然卖淫无法合法的存在，但是卖淫本身可以不合法存在。
en: But as the saying goes, although prostitution cannot exist legally, prostitution itself can exist without being made legal.

text: ——就像996和拖欠工资…
en: —just like 996 and wage arrears…

text: 不合法，但存在…
en: Not legal, yet it exists…

text: 卖淫合法化→男性可以合法 便捷 高性价的处理性需求→结婚意愿降低→生育率降低→人口（税基）减少→房产 家电 教育等税收减少→政府没钱给自己发工资和高额养老金
en: Legalisation of prostitution → men can satisfy sexual needs legally, conveniently and at low cost → willingness to marry falls → birth rate falls → population (tax base) shrinks → taxes on property, household appliances, education, etc. decrease → the government has no money to pay its own salaries and hefty pensions

text: 你以为是道德问题，其实是统治问题
en: You think it is a moral issue; in fact it is a matter of governance.

text: 很多地方, 比如香港卖淫合法的前提, 是考虑到卖淫如果是完全非法化的, 那这个行为就会被组织化隐蔽, 然后有组织犯罪就会用卖淫行为逼迫欠款方还债, 形成高利贷放贷-强迫卖淫催收的一条龙, 打击起来还特别费劲, 而且这样对社团来说也有了发展资本. 甚至放贷本行为本身跟贩毒是相关的, 社会危害性极大.
en: In many places, such as Hong Kong, the premise for legalising prostitution is that, considering that if prostitution were made entirely illegal the activity would be driven underground and organised, organised crime would then use prostitution to force debtors to repay, forming a one-stop operation of loan-sharking and forced-prostitution debt collection that is especially hard to crack down on; moreover, this gives the syndicates capital to expand. Even the act of lending itself is linked to drug trafficking, posing an immense danger to society.

text: 所以就把卖淫局限成一楼风的模式, 然后营业位置早就被警察摸清楚了, 只要有有组织/中介人, 或者是非法外劳, 就直接认定不合法.
en: Thus prostitution is confined to the one-woman brothel model, and the operating locations have long since been mapped out by the police; whenever there is an organisation or intermediary, or illegal foreign labour, it is directly ruled illegal.

text: 新加坡更是实用主义, 就像奴隶一样坐敞篷卡车的外劳一样, 性工作者只能从国外引进, 然后强制设定最长工作时间限制, 干个几年就回去了.
en: Singapore is even more pragmatic; just as foreign workers ride in open-top trucks like slaves, sex workers can only be imported from abroad, with a mandatory maximum working-hours limit imposed, and after working a few years they return home.

text: 而我国在卖淫非法化的情况下, 实际上高利贷靠强迫卖淫征收的情况还是有的, 要打击? 不好意思, 人家有组织犯罪, 环节分工明确, 打击起来比人家单独做单独收款高多了, 后者地方上动不动打击创收, 不要太简单.
en: Yet under our country's criminalisation of prostitution, there are in fact still cases of loan sharks using forced prostitution to collect debts. Want to crack down? Sorry, but they are organised crime with clearly divided roles, and cracking down on them is far harder than on those who operate and collect individually — the latter local authorities crack down on at the drop of a hat to generate revenue, which is all too easy.

text: 所以你知道为什么全面非法化了吧, 毕竟打到一个就罚没收入, 对岸政府也是这么干的.
en: So now you understand why it is made fully illegal — after all, catching one means confiscating their earnings, and the government across the strait does exactly the same.

text: 而北欧先进国家都是惩罚嫖客, 德国这种就是相对容忍, 但是前提是得交税和严格执行公共卫生规范.
en: Nordic advanced nations all punish the clients, while Germany is relatively tolerant, but on the condition that taxes must be paid and public-health regulations strictly enforced.

text: 法律的神圣性并非源于国家背书，而是来自于公正公平本身。
en: The sanctity of law does not derive from state endorsement, but from fairness and justice themselves.

text: 当法律不保护一部分人（男性）的时候，事实上也就失去保护剩余部分人（女性）的意义了，只不过惯性还会持续一段时间，但最终还是会不可避免的滑向黑暗森林社会
en: When the law fails to protect one part of the people (men), it in fact loses the meaning of protecting the remaining part (women); it is only that inertia will persist for a while, but in the end it will inevitably slide into a dark-forest society.

text: 我认为卖淫合法化一定会导致个人与组织的不平等对抗。
en: I believe the legalisation of prostitution will inevitably lead to an unequal confrontation between individuals and organisations.

text: 996就是一个例子，个人对抗组织的结果，也别天天在那说只要个人做好一二三四…
en: 996 is one example — the result of individuals confronting organisations — so stop saying all the time that as long as individuals get one, two, three, four right…

text: 九十就可以不被组织欺骗了，可以保护自己的权益了，可以把部分极端的不合法了之类的。
en: nine, ten — then they can avoid being deceived by the organisation, can protect their own rights and make some of the extreme practices illegal, and so on.

text: 先把996解决了再说这种大话，到时候环境一变，肯定出大问题。
en: First resolve 996 before spouting such big talk; once the environment shifts, big problems will surely arise.

text: 很多人就是只拿目前环境的缺点和新环境的优点比，拉偏架的姿态太难看了。
en: Many people merely compare the shortcomings of the current environment with the merits of the new one; their posture of taking sides is utterly ungraceful.

text: 很简单，一旦合法了
en: Simple: once it is legalised,

text: 高彩礼不存在了，财富转移没了，自己辛苦赚的钱谁会大手大脚得去消费？
en: high bride prices vanish, wealth transfer disappears — who would spend their hard-earned money so recklessly?

text: 不用结婚就能得到管控专营资源，够自己吃喝p了，简单就能得到满足，谁还去卷
en: Without marrying, one can obtain the managed, exclusive resources; enough to eat, drink and amuse oneself, satisfaction attained with ease — who would still grind away in competition?

text: 长期的好，日租的坏
en: The good of the long-term, the bad of the daily rental.

text: 就算反驳了那些“支持的人”又怎么样？
en: Even if you refute those 'people who support it', so what?

text: 你能反驳这个麦子熟了几千次都客观存在的现实吗？
en: Can you refute the reality that has objectively existed across thousands of wheat harvests?

text: 从唯物主义的角度看，卖淫就是大量现实客观存在的。
en: From a materialist perspective, prostitution is something that objectively exists in great quantities in reality.

text: 而且不同于毒品等行当，那只是政府打击不完，实际执行就是按照见一个打一个，除了个别头铁不要的命的，没有官员敢实际灰色管辖。
en: Moreover, unlike the drug trade and such, which the government simply cannot finish cracking down on — in actual enforcement it is dealt with on a catch-as-catch-can basis, and except for the odd death-defying hothead, no official dares to actually exercise grey-area control.

text: 而黄实际上都是在官方管理之下客观存在的，只是明面上的按法律管辖，还是潜规则下的灰色管辖。
en: Yet prostitution in fact objectively exists under official management; it is merely a question of whether it is governed openly by law or governed in the grey area under unspoken rules.

text: 并且全世界所有国家都这样，不管是宣传合法的还是不合法的，色情业都是实际上政府或者政府的代言人在进行管控的。
en: And all countries in the world are like this: whether they proclaim it legal or illegal, the sex industry is in fact controlled by the government or by the government's proxies.

text: 并且这个行业的需求来源和运营模式从物质本质上讲就是普通的服务行业，和按摩、洗脚、陪游、导游等没有任何区别，都是一方付出个人服务，满足一方天性需求的一种交易。
en: Moreover, the source of demand and the operating model of this industry are, in material essence, no different from an ordinary service industry — indistinguishable from massage, foot baths, travel companions, tour guides and the like; in every case one party provides a personal service and the other satisfies a natural need, a transaction.

text: 因为性需求不同于毒品需求，这是正常需求，人类自然天性。
en: For sexual need differs from drug addiction; it is a normal need, a natural human instinct.

text: 性交易也不同于偷抢拐骗等犯罪式的零和博弈，只有单纯财产的转移而不是交易。
en: Sex transactions also differ from zero-sum criminal games such as theft, robbery, abduction and fraud, which involve merely the transfer rather than the exchange of property.

text: 并且出售性服务的一方在保证措施的前提下对身体也是无害的，和卖血这些还不同。
en: And the party selling sexual services, provided protective measures are taken, suffers no harm to the body either — unlike selling blood.

text: 不基于这些客观事实，讨论卖淫合法化与否没有意义，就只能沦为道德观点的PK以及情绪发泄罢了。
en: Without grounding the discussion in these objective facts, debating whether prostitution should be legalised is meaningless; it can only degenerate into a clash of moral viewpoints and emotional venting.

text: 你反驳不反驳这些人，你也赢不了，这一行业也不会消失，政府也打不完，也实际上会进行管理。
en: Whether you refute these people or not, you cannot win; this industry will not disappear, the government cannot eradicate it, and it will in fact exercise management.

text: 说白了，卖淫合法化这事讨论的根本不是应不应该有卖淫。
en: To put it bluntly, the debate over legalising prostitution is fundamentally not about whether prostitution should exist.

text: 实际上就是政府要不要把一个不可改变、肯定存在、并且当前灰色管理的行业摆到台面上进行正规化管理而已。
en: It is simply a question of whether the government should bring an unalterable, certain-to-exist, and currently grey-area-managed industry out into the open for proper, formal regulation.
